subtitle: Out Manila · Chang An Airlines (charter)
overview: A no-shopping charter package through Zhangjiajie, home of the Avatar scenery at Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, plus the Grand Canyon Glass Bridge, Furong Town, Tianmen Mountain and the Yangtze River Three Gorges. Flights are by charter with Chang An Airlines.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 23–27 2026 to Dec 23–27 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Yichang – Zhangjiajie
items: Charter flight Manila to Yichang (9H8384 02:40/05:25); meet the guide.
Transfer to hotel for breakfast and rest until 11am, then check out and drive to Zhangjiajie.
Visit Grand Canyon scenic area and the Glass Bridge.
Visit Furong Town, the ancient town hanging on a waterfall, and see its night view.
Transfer to hotel. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Furong Town – Zhangjiajie
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Visit Tusi City.
Visit Tianmen Mountain (cable car, glass skywalk and Tianmen Cave included).
Transfer to hotel. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie
items: Hotel breakfast.
Avatar scenic area, up and down by Bailong Lift: No.1 Bridge, Avatar Hallelujah Mountain, Breath-taking Platform and West Sea Clouds.
Optional tour: Tianmen Fox-Lady Show (USD 70 per person).
After dinner, transfer to hotel. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie – Yichang
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Visit Baofeng Lake (cruise included).
Proceed to Yichang; after dinner, check in at hotel. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie – Yichang – Manila
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Visit the Yangtze River Three Gorges Tribe Scenic Area (cruise included).
Visit Qu Yuan’s hometown and San You Cave.
Transfer to Yichang airport for the flight to Manila (9H8383 23:00/01:40+1). Meals: B/L/X.

placeDesc.Grand Canyon Glass Bridge: A glass-floored suspension bridge spanning a deep canyon near Zhangjiajie.
placeDesc.Furong Town: An ancient town built on a cliff beside a waterfall, seen on an evening visit.
placeDesc.Tusi City: A Tujia ethnic cultural site in Zhangjiajie, visited on Day 2.
placeDesc.Tianmen Mountain: A mountain near Zhangjiajie visited by cable car, with a glass skywalk and the Tianmen Cave.
placeDesc.Zhangjiajie National Forest Park (Avatar: A park of towering sandstone pillars that inspired the floating mountains of the film Avatar.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A tall outdoor glass elevator that carries visitors up the cliff face to the scenic area.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: The pillar peak that inspired the floating Hallelujah Mountains in the film Avatar.
placeDesc.Baofeng Lake: A mountain lake between steep cliffs, explored on a cruise.
placeDesc.Three Gorges Tribe Scenic Area: A Yangtze River gorge scenic area visited by cruise, with local Tujia culture.
placeDesc.Qu Yuan’s hometown: The birthplace area of the ancient poet Qu Yuan, visited near Yichang on the last day.
placeDesc.San You Cave: A scenic cave and gorge site near Yichang, visited before the flight home.
